title: Creature Journals
description: A book button in the Token HUD (right-click a token) that opens a journal belonging to that creature. GM only: players never see the button, and the journals are hidden from them unless the GM shows one. Each creature type gets a shared journal, and any single token can have its own; the button opens the token's own if it has one, otherwise the creature type's, and creates the first one on demand in a 'Creature Journals' folder.
